title: Elevated — RGBA & TBC, 4K for Windows
author: RGBA & TBC, PRISM
notes: Breakpoint 2009, 4K intro, first place: mountains flown over at sunset, their height map made by the program's own function through D3DXFillTexture, a D3DX square cut by N-patches into a million triangles that a vertex shader raises, the camera computed on the GPU and read back each frame, music by Puryx synthesized before the first frame; packed by Crinkler. MIRAGE-WIN32 makes d3d9.dll and d3dx9_33.dll in JavaScript, its meshes included; PRISM's d3d9.js translates the HLSL to GLSL ES and draws it with WebGL2. The precalculation takes some 24 billion instructions: about two and a half minutes of black screen before the mountains.
